mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.1% compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.1%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.5%, the Federal Reserve initiates monetary tightening, increasing equity discount rates and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.5% (y/y), or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate broad consumer demand contraction, triggering negative equity sentiment and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline > 0.5% m/m
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST and RSAFS both decline > 0.5% m/m, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In high-unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 6.0%), the Federal Reserve adopts accommodative policy, supporting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 6.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production indicates robust manufacturing activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is rising, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 1500 thousand units, it signals housing market contraction, reducing consumer confidence and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST < 1500.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Reserve raises rates in response to inflation (FEDFUNDS > 0.1% and CPIAUCSL > 3.0% y/y), monetary tightening reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.1% and CPIAUCSL > 3.0% (y/y), or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In slow-growth regimes (GDPC1 growth < 1.0% annualized), the Federal Reserve maintains accommodative policy, supporting equity markets and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 growth < 1.0% annualized, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window falls below 0.02.
